question: Will Trump livestream an execution?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the general American public can obtain live footage of Nidal Malik Hasan being executed. I'll also resolve NO if Trump clearly states that he isn't going through with it.
research:
## Research brief: will the public get live footage of Nidal Hasan's execution?

Note: several search results were dated after 2026-10-13. I left them out as instructed. Every page I tried to fetch was blocked by the proxy, so the facts below come from search snippets and could not be checked against the full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no official data source. The question resolves YES if the public can get live footage of Hasan's execution. It resolves NO if Trump clearly says the livestream will not happen.
- 2026-10-09: The Pentagon said the firing squad execution will be livestreamed. It is set for **December 3, 2026** at Fort Hood, Texas. [PBS/AP](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/pentagon-says-firing-squad-execution-of-fort-hood-shooter-will-be-livestreamed), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/09/nx-s1-5996529/firing-squad-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter)
- Because the execution is scheduled after the resolution date (about 2026-10-15), YES cannot happen by then. Before December, the question can only settle early through a clear "no livestream" statement from Trump.

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-10-13)
- Nothing settled the question by 2026-10-13. Hegseth and the Pentagon backed the livestream, and Trump had said he had not made a final decision.
- Trump's statements in reporting before 10-13 point in different directions:
  - He said he "absolutely" approved the plan.
  - In another interview he said he "wasn't involved in that decision."
  - At a "Saturday" appearance (probably 2026-10-10) he said he had not made a final decision. He gave arguments both ways, including that showing it might deter others, and said "I know what the military would like to do, but I'll make a decision." [NBC Washington](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/trump-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-hasan/)
  - I could not confirm the exact dates of these remarks.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-13: Axios published an explainer on how firing squads work, still treating the livestream as Hegseth's plan. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/10/13/execution-nidal-hasan-firing-squad-hegseth-stream)
- About 2026-10-10: Trump said a final decision was still pending (see section 2). [NBC Washington](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/trump-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-hasan/)
- 2026-10-10: CNN reported the Army was caught off guard by Hegseth's order to make the execution public and was scrambling to plan it. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/10/politics/pentagon-scramble-hegseth-public-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Vice President JD Vance doubted the plan: "I don't know that that's actually going to happen." He said he would not watch. Trump stayed noncommittal and did not answer whether he would watch. [WTOC/AP](https://www.wtoc.com/2026/10/09/vance-expresses-doubts-about-pentagon-plan-livestream-fort-hood-shooters-execution/), [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/world/vance-says-he-wont-watch-livestream-of-execution-trump-remains-silent/3067210/)
- 2026-10-09: Criticism came from both parties. Republican Rep. Austin Scott said livestreaming executions is what Islamist militants do. Republican Sen. John Curtis urged Hegseth to reconsider. FCC Chair Carr also appears in Inquirer coverage, but I could not read what he said. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/09/politics/fort-hood-execution-hegseth-livestream), [Inquirer](https://www.inquirer.com/news/nation-world/livestream-execution-hasan-firing-squad-hegseth-pentagon-vance-carr-fcc-20261009.html), [MS NOW](https://www.ms.now/rachel-maddow-show/maddowblog/hegseth-hasan-execution-firing-squad-livestream-pushback)
- 2026-10-08/09: Hegseth announced the execution would be public, and the Pentagon confirmed a livestream the next day. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/09/nx-s1-5996529/firing-squad-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter)

## 4. Base rates
- The US has never publicly broadcast an execution. The last public execution in the US was in 1936, and federal and military executions have always had limited, invited witnesses.
- The last US military execution was in 1961 (John Bennett). Hasan was sentenced to death in 2013. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment_by_the_United_States_military)
- Trump-era pattern: a controversial Pentagon or Hegseth plan that draws pushback from both parties, including senior Republicans, sometimes gets reversed or softened by Trump after a few days. I did not find a measured base rate for this.
- For the resolution window, the main question is whether Trump issues a clear "no" statement by about 10-15.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question. Kalshi has a history of cancelling death-related markets on ethical grounds, so a listed market is unlikely. [Forklog](https://forklog.com/news/polzovateli-kalshi-poteryali-dengi-na-otmenennoj-po-eticheskoj-prichine-stavke)
- I found no published expert forecasts. Vance's public doubt on 10-09 is the closest thing to an insider signal.

## 6. Upcoming events
- Trump's "final decision," which he said was still pending. It could come through Truth Social, a press gaggle or an interview, at any time.
- Possible statements from the Pentagon or Hegseth, and continued Republican pushback in Congress.
- Possible lawsuits over the broadcast, or Hasan's remaining appeals. I found no filings dated before 10-13.
- 2026-12-03: the scheduled execution at Fort Hood, after the resolution date.
